method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: it shows a sinuous river reach with labels 甲 and 乙 on opposite sides of the channel. Read the poem’s key clues: “数家新住处，昔日大江流” means the new houses stand where the great river once flowed; “古岸崩欲尽，平沙长未休” indicates simultaneous bank erosion and continuing sand deposition. In the figure, choose the place that represents newly deposited flat sand/land left behind by channel migration rather than the eroding old bank. That place is 乙, so “数家新住处” should be at 乙地.
